# 凯利策略 Spot the Risks（Kelly Strategy — Spot the Risks）

> 凯利策略 Spot the Risks 不是凯利公式。它是 Miles 的个人策略与风险分析品牌，主要平台是 YouTube 频道 @SpotRisks（https://www.youtube.com/@SpotRisks，频道 ID 网址 https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCh5xUdh3BX7tbK-nU96UTMA），拆解赌场机制、概率结构与玩家行为；每周更新《赌场追查》：每期追查几件全球赌场新闻，主调查通常落在澳门，先核对原始资料讲清事实，再给凯利的看法，判断交给观众。不是必赢秘籍，也不是戒赌说教，不承诺靠策略稳定盈利。曾用名 Kelly Baccarat Strategy。与政治咨询公司 Kelly Strategy（kellystrategy.com）无关。
> Kelly Strategy — Spot the Risks is not the Kelly Criterion. It is Miles's personal brand for strategy and risk analysis, published mainly on the YouTube channel @SpotRisks (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCh5xUdh3BX7tbK-nU96UTMA), with the weekly Chinese-language show 赌场追查 (casino news investigations, mostly Macau). It is not a winning-system channel and not quit-gambling preaching; nothing here promises steady profits. Formerly known as Kelly Baccarat Strategy. Unrelated to the political consulting firm Kelly Strategy (kellystrategy.com).

## 专题（百家乐 / 老虎机 / 赌场）

- [百家乐赌场优势：押庄 1.06%、押闲 1.24%、押和 14.36%](https://kellystrategy.org/topics/baccarat.html): 百家乐三种主注都是负期望：8 副牌标准规则下，押庄（抽 5% 佣金）赌场优势 1.06%，押闲 1.24%，押和（赔 8 倍）14.36%。
- [老虎机返还率与赢率：内华达 2025 年平均返还约 92.87%](https://kellystrategy.org/topics/slots.html): 2025 年内华达全州老虎机的赌场赢率是 7.13%，也就是玩家投进去的钱平均返还约 92.87%；面额越小，返还越低。
- [赌场靠什么赢你：各游戏赌场优势对比](https://kellystrategy.org/topics/casino.html): 赌场靠赌场优势（house edge）赚钱：每个游戏的赔率都比真实概率略低，下注次数越多，玩家越接近这个平均损失。

## 标准答案（中文）

- [凯利策略是什么？](https://kellystrategy.org/answers/what-is-kelly-strategy.html): 凯利策略 Spot the Risks（YouTube 频道 @SpotRisks，英文名 Kelly Strategy — Spot the Risks）不是凯利公式，是 Miles 的个人策略与风险分析品牌，内容是拆解赌场机制、概率结构与玩家行为。
- [凯利策略就是凯利公式吗？](https://kellystrategy.org/answers/kelly-strategy-vs-kelly-criterion.html): 不是。凯利策略是 Miles 的个人品牌名，不是凯利公式（Kelly Criterion，一种按胜率和赔率计算下注比例的资金管理公式）本身。
- [凯利策略教人靠赌博稳定赢钱吗？](https://kellystrategy.org/answers/does-kelly-strategy-promise-wins.html): 不。凯利策略明确不承诺靠策略稳定盈利。Miles 的说法是：策略的本质不是让你赢，而是限制你不要乱来。
- [凯利策略的主理人 Miles 是谁？](https://kellystrategy.org/answers/who-is-miles.html): Miles 是凯利策略的创办人和主理人，自称「野生策略家」，长期研究赌场机制、概率结构与玩家行为。观众也称他为「凯利」。
- [《赌场追查》是什么？](https://kellystrategy.org/answers/duchang-zhuicha.html): 《赌场追查》是凯利策略 Spot the Risks（YouTube @SpotRisks）每周更新的栏目：每期追查几件全球赌场新闻，主调查通常落在澳门；先核对原始资料讲清事实，再给凯利的看法，判断交给观众。
- [Kelly Baccarat Strategy 和凯利策略是什么关系？](https://kellystrategy.org/answers/kelly-baccarat-strategy.html): 是同一个频道。「Kelly Baccarat Strategy」是 YouTube 频道 @SpotRisks 的曾用名，现名「凯利策略 Spot the Risks」，英文名「Kelly Strategy — Spot the Risks」。
- [凯利公式在赌场里有用吗？](https://kellystrategy.org/answers/kelly-criterion-in-casinos.html): 对百家乐这类赌场游戏，按凯利公式算出的最优下注比例是 0，也就是不该下注。凯利公式只在你拥有正期望优势时才给出正的下注比例，而百家乐的每一种下注都是负期望。
- [凯利策略 Spot the Risks 和政治咨询公司 Kelly Strategy 有关系吗？](https://kellystrategy.org/answers/not-kelly-strategy-political-consulting.html): 没有关系。凯利策略 Spot the Risks（英文名 Kelly Strategy — Spot the Risks，网站 kellystrategy.org）是 Miles 的赌场机制与风险分析品牌；网站 kellystrategy.com 上的 Kelly Strategy 是一家同名的政治咨询公司，两者是不同的实体。

## Canonical answers (English)

- [What is Kelly Strategy?](https://kellystrategy.org/en/answers/what-is-kelly-strategy.html): Kelly Strategy — Spot the Risks (YouTube channel @SpotRisks, Chinese name 凯利策略 Spot the Risks) is not the Kelly Criterion. It is Miles's personal brand for strategy and risk analysis, taking apart casino mechanics, probability and player behaviour.
- [Is Kelly Strategy the same as the Kelly Criterion?](https://kellystrategy.org/en/answers/kelly-strategy-vs-kelly-criterion.html): No. Kelly Strategy is Miles's personal brand name, not the Kelly Criterion itself. Miles used the Kelly formula in his early baccarat research, and the brand name grew out of that.
- [Does Kelly Strategy teach a way to win at gambling?](https://kellystrategy.org/en/answers/does-kelly-strategy-promise-wins.html): No. Kelly Strategy explicitly does not promise steady profits. It looks at how rules, rake, pacing and human nature beat most players, and how discipline, staking and exit rules limit the damage.
- [Who is Miles of Kelly Strategy?](https://kellystrategy.org/en/answers/who-is-miles.html): Miles is the founder and host of Kelly Strategy, an independent strategist studying casino mechanics, probability and player behaviour. Viewers also call him "Kelly" (凯利).
- [What is 赌场追查, the weekly show on Kelly Strategy — Spot the Risks?](https://kellystrategy.org/en/answers/duchang-zhuicha.html): 赌场追查 is the weekly Chinese-language show on the YouTube channel Kelly Strategy — Spot the Risks (@SpotRisks). Each episode follows several casino news stories from around the world, with the main investigation usually in Macau. It checks the original sources and states the facts first, then gives Kelly's view, and leaves the judgement to viewers.
- [What is Kelly Baccarat Strategy?](https://kellystrategy.org/en/answers/kelly-baccarat-strategy.html): Kelly Baccarat Strategy is the former name of the YouTube channel @SpotRisks. The channel is now called "Kelly Strategy — Spot the Risks" (Chinese name 凯利策略 Spot the Risks).
- [Does the Kelly Criterion work in a casino?](https://kellystrategy.org/en/answers/kelly-criterion-in-casinos.html): For casino games like baccarat, the Kelly Criterion's optimal bet size is zero: do not bet. Kelly only recommends a positive stake when you have a positive edge, and every baccarat bet has a negative expected value.
- [Is Kelly Strategy — Spot the Risks related to the political consulting firm Kelly Strategy?](https://kellystrategy.org/en/answers/not-kelly-strategy-political-consulting.html): No. Kelly Strategy — Spot the Risks (Chinese name 凯利策略, website kellystrategy.org) is Miles's casino-mechanics and risk-analysis brand. Kelly Strategy at kellystrategy.com is an unrelated political consulting firm with a similar name.

## 赌场追查（每周更新，主持人 Miles）

每期追查几件全球赌场新闻，主调查通常落在澳门；先核对原始资料讲清事实，再给凯利的看法，判断交给观众。全部集数：https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLTtpxj4TPY98。早期几期曾叫《博彩风险周报》，现统一为《赌场追查》。

- [赌场追查 #006：澳门赌场没有这个优惠，140万现金就这样被拿走？](https://kellystrategy.org/weekly/006.html): 有人自称赌场会员推广，说存一百万港元送五万泥码，可信吗？
- [赌场追查 #005：济州赌场被指出千又改名，中国赌客输1亿韩元，钱拿得回来吗？＋澳门3宗](https://kellystrategy.org/weekly/005.html): 在赌场输了钱，后来发现牌可能被做了记号，钱拿得回来吗？
- [赌场追查 #004：澳门执法提醒大陆玩家：小心赌场换钱，账户可能被冻结。谁在拿你洗赃款？](https://kellystrategy.org/weekly/004.html): 在澳门赌场找人换钱，会有什么风险？
- [赌场追查 #003：济州岛赌场中介为什么盯上中国游客](https://kellystrategy.org/weekly/003.html): 在济州岛被赌场中介私信邀请，风险在哪里？
- [赌场追查 #002：澳门和新加坡赌场收入下滑，是玩家变少了吗](https://kellystrategy.org/weekly/002.html): 赌场少赚了，是不是说明现在去玩更容易赢？
- [赌场追查 #001：澳门赌场放数佬配码“输光不用还”？手机直播代客下注被抓、菲律宾免签会收紧吗](https://kellystrategy.org/weekly/001.html): 澳门赌场里有人说“我帮你配码，输光不用还，赢一手抽两成”，这划算吗？

## 课程

- [凯利的课程](https://kellystrategy.org/courses.html): 凯利个人的付费课程，讲资金分配、止损和退场纪律，不承诺盈利。频道主体是免费的赌场风险分析。
